title: Fix the auto_assign_agent and resolve_raised_by_name follow-up business-logic fu
description:
The automatic agent assignment on the Create Ticket screen is still not working. A new ticket with category NETWORK stays Pending with no agent, even though agent 01 SANDEEP (Preference NETWORK) is Active and Available. No error is shown.

Please fix the auto-assignment step that runs after a new ticket is added:
1. Make sure it actually runs for every new ticket. Check how the steps that run after a ticket is added are registered, and why none of them seem to produce results (Raised By Name is also empty on every ticket).
2. Read the new ticket's number and category code correctly. Accept both lowercase and uppercase field names, the same way the working steps in this screen read their values.
3. Find the category name from the Category Master using the category code, and match it with the agent's Preference, ignoring capital letters and extra spaces.
4. If the matching agent is Available, save the agent on the ticket and set Status to Assigned. Assigned Agent and Status are protected fields, so make sure the save really takes effect.
5. If the agent is Occupied, or no Active agent matches, leave the ticket Pending with no agent and no error shown to the employee.
6. Add a clear log message at every point where this step stops early, giving the reason, and a message with the number of rows updated when it succeeds.
7. If anything fails inside this step, log the error and let the ticket save normally.

Do not change anything else.

todos.label: Fix auto_assign_agent follow-up logic to read fields case-insensitively, match preference case/whitespace-insensitively, and persist the protected ASSIGNED_AGENT/STATUS update
Fix resolve_raised_by_name follow-up logic to read RAISED_BY case-insensitively and persist the protected RAISED_BY_NAME column
